limitations: Version pins installed frontend build plus engine asset SHA-256, not an inferred server release number; UPM release metadata is inaccessible (401).
Bryntum Gantt engine observed as 5.4.1. Local MppReader scheduler results are not plugin evidence.
Only the stated control scopes are verified. Type+nonzero lag combinations other than FS have no live proof.
Elapsed eday encoding failed; other elapsed encodings, varied daily intervals, inheritance/workweeks/recurrences and task/resource/assignment calendar bindings remain not_verified.
Representation conversion does not establish schedule equality for arbitrary source plans. Exact source dates and per-task comparison remain separate.
Work is displayed in diagnostics only; no work block is published in storage.

Corrective cycle 17.11.2026: nested calendar children, task binding, FixedUnits, SNET/FNET, segments with source-derived duration, inactive and summary endpoints verified independently. Native actuals, arbitrary assignment offsets, independent resource calendars and availability remain not_verified; narrow default-availability and coincident-assignment transformations have separate controls.
Source facts customtext are verified independently of scheduling; native summary percent aggregates and is not the source summary percent.
